text:
Akash (Support): FYI customer 'AtlasHealth' reported a perf regression on their Dedicated cluster after last week's rollout. 95th p50 spikes from ~120ms to ~900ms on embed requests. They want ETA for a fix, asking whether this can be a patch or must wait for next release.
Maria (PM): Thanks Akash. Do we have reproducer & logs? Severity to the customer? SLA impact?
Akash (Support): They've got a steady 3% error budget burn, and business impact is moderate-high (search UX degraded). Repro steps in case 3242, minimal steps: set model=redwood-v1-quant, seq_len=1024, endpoint dedicated-prod-42. Logs: `ERR kv_cache_miss rate 0.9` and `latency_token_ms 12 -> 85` per token.
Jordan (SRE): Can we repro in staging? If it's kv cache churn that would explain token latency. Need a simple script to hit same seq_len & model.
Priya (Backend): I can reproduce locally with their workload pattern — looks like our prefix cache eviction is thrashing when requests vary prefix length. Patch idea: make eviction policy LRU-with-weight or add a tiny grace window to not evict active sessions. Estimate: 1-2d to implement + tests.
Lucas (Releases): If fix is straightforward + low-risk, we can do an out-of-band patch and canary it. Need owner, PR, test plan, and rollback. If it's >2d, might be safer for next scheduled minor release.
Maria (PM): Customer is pushing for calendar week timeline. Can we commit to a hotfix with canary if Priya says 1-2d?
Priya (Backend): I can scope a minimal safe change today: 1) change eviction grace to 200ms, 2) add metric for cache churn and a feature flag. That avoids algorithm switchover. Impl + unit tests = ~16-20h. Integration + canary = another 8-12h.
Jordan (SRE): Plan for canary: deploy to dedicated-prod-42 only (their pool) first, then 5% cross-customer canary, monitor latency + errors for 2 hours, then 25% for 1 hour, then full. Rollback script ready.
Lucas (Releases): Window: do it during low traffic window 02:00-06:00 UTC tomorrow. Need CI green + infra prechecks. I'll own the deploy runbook.
Akash (Support): I'll ACK with customer: propose hotfix + canary tomorrow during 02:00-06:00 UTC, ask for permission to run on their pool first.
Maria (PM): Decision: Hotfix (out-of-band) with feature-flagged change, canary to customer pool -> staged ramp. Owners: Priya (fix + PR), Lucas (deploy/runbook), Jordan (monitoring & rollback), Akash (customer comms).
Priya (Backend): Creating PR branch `fix/cache-grace-1753` now. I'll add feature flag `cache_grace_ms` (default 0 -> will be set to 200 in canary).
OpsBot: Ticket created: PROD-11234 "Dedicated cache churn causing latency for AtlasHealth" assigned to Priya. Link: https://tickets.redwood/prod/11234
Jordan (SRE): Monitoring hooks to add: latency_p50/95 per-token, kv_cache_miss_rate, cpu/gpu_util, error_rate. I'll add alerts (sev2 if p95 > 400ms for 10m).
Lucas (Releases): Runbook checklist: PR merged, CI: unit+integration green, infra prechecks ok, rollback steps documented, canary gate thresholds set, comms sent to support & customer.
Akash (Support): I'll update case 3242 with the plan + scheduled time, will ping product & sales for customer approval.
Maria (PM): Add a short public-facing note for customers on status page if canary triggers any visible issues. Keep messaging concise: root cause suspected cache churn, hotfix in progress, expected rollback if issues.
Priya (Backend): PR: https://git.redwood/pr/4982 — pushing tests. Tagging @Jordan & @Lucas for review.
Jordan (SRE): Reviewing now. Quick comment: make sure feature flag respects timeout per-worker, not global.
Lucas (Releases): Once PR approved, I'll slot deploy for 02:15 UTC tomorrow (so we can monitor through the window).
Akash (Support): Customer approved canary on their pool. Thx team.
Maria (PM): Great. Let's keep updates light in this thread. Post-deploy: brief status + retrospective notes.
Priya (Backend): Merging PR in ~1h after final test. Will post status here.
Akash (Support): I'll update case after merge and again post-canary.
Lucas (Releases): Noted. I'll orchestrate canary & rollback if thresholds hit.
Jordan (SRE): I'll be on watch during canary window. Slack pings enabled.
Maria (PM): Action items recap: Priya fix & PR, Lucas deploy/runbook, Jordan monitoring/alerts, Akash customer comms. Expected timeline: deploy tomorrow 02:15-04:00 UTC.
Akash (Support): Copy.
Priya (Backend): PR merged. Will post canary start timestamp here when I flip flag.
OpsBot: Deployment scheduled by Lucas for 1753086900 (02:15 UTC).
Lucas (Releases): Canary started on customer pool — flipping flag for dedicated-prod-42. Monitoring now.
Jordan (SRE): Initial metrics look good: p95 down to ~150ms for test cohort. No error increase so far.
Akash (Support): Customer confirms improvement on their side. :tada:
Maria (PM): Thanks all. Postmortem + retention action (if needed) after full rollout.
Priya (Backend): Will open a follow-up ticket to consider longer-term cache policy improvements (non-hotfix scope).
Lucas (Releases): Full ramp scheduled if canary stable: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over next 4 hours.
Jordan (SRE): Will close monitoring window once stable.
Maria (PM): Closing thread for now — please update tickets and case.
Akash (Support): Case updated, customer thanked us.
